veranderings.blok: Erfenis help vorm wie jy is
veranderings.na: Wie jy is en waar jy hoort, noem ons jou identiteit.
veranderings.rede: 'dit' can be read as pointing back to 'sulke dinge' (language and festivals) rather than to who you are and where you belong, which is what identity means in the glossary; naming the referent removes the ambiguity.

veranderings.voor: kom saam om te sing en te dans
veranderings.na: kom bymekaar om te sing en te dans
veranderings.rede: 'kom saam' reads first as 'come along'; 'kom bymekaar' says plainly that people gather.
